text: Nice!. Very nice looking rug, put some carpet tape on the ends to hold it down and it's staying in place perfectly. Love it I can't rate stain resistance or if it's easy to clean since I just got it today.

product_metadata.title: Unique Loom Sofia Collection Area Rug - Larvotto (7' 10" Square, Brown/ Beige)
features: Soft 0.25" (1/4") pile height. Made of 100% polypropylene and power loomed in Turkey. 100% jute backing is safe for all floor types, including hardwood floors.

French-inspired vintage traditional designs from Unique Loom's Sofia Collection enhance any room of the home. From the living room, dining room, bedroom, entryway, nursery, dorm room, study, foyer, mudroom, bathroom, home office, kitchen, and more.

Available in all shapes, sizes, and colors, you'll find the right rug for you. A round or square rug for your dining room, large rug for your living room, runner for your kitchen, or hard to find shapes like oval rugs or octagon rugs is one click away.

In case of creases - roll the rug in the opposite direction, while applying pressure to the rug - take the edge, flip it where there is a crease, and slowly pull the rug back, while applying a downward pressure on the crease.
Spot cleaning and regular vacuuming is recommended - you can use a carpet cleaner (shampooer), but it should be dried immediately and evenly.
description: Transform any space into a travel destination with the Sofia Collection’s French-inspired designs. Overdyed threads make vivid colors pop, capturing all the pizzazz of the high-energy locale. Bon voyage!

details.Product Care Instructions: As long as it's a short-pile, indoor rug, we recommend spot cleaning with resolve, and regular vacuuming is recommended - you can use a carpet cleaner (shampooer) but it should be dried immediately and evenly
